text: New Era Cap is family-owned by the founding Koch family, who have run it since 1920 with fourth-generation CEO Chris Koch; private equity firm ACON Investments, an investor since 2021, holds a "significant" stake, and the NFL, NBA and MLB acquired minority stakes in 2022.
short: New Era Cap is family-owned by the founding Koch family; ACON holds a significant stake

source.name: Associated Press (via Arizona Daily Star, tucson.com): New Era Cap purchasing '47 brand
source.quote: Similarly, the Koch family has run New Era since its beginning in 1920.
source.note: Same AP article: Koch is "the fourth-generation CEO of the family-owned company"; ACON Investments "will hold a ‘significant’ stake in the combined company"; "The NFL, NBA and MLB acquired minority stakes in New Era during a 2022 fundraising round."
